summary: Skye Bioscience entered a transaction agreement to acquire Redx Pharma via a UK scheme of arrangement, exchanging each Scheme Share for Skye common stock (or non-voting common stock convertible 1:1) based on an Exchange Ratio. Redx separately agreed to a $36.0 million Series A financing before closing. The deal requires shareholder approvals from both companies. Skye is the acquirer; Redx is the target. Advisors were not named in the excerpt. A key watch item is the exchange ratio mechanics and regulatory timeline, as well as the risk-arb spread between Skye stock and the implied deal value.
